newsitem.title: GREECE: Greece's Endysi goes public Nov 29-Dec 3.
newsitem.headline: Greece's Endysi goes public Nov 29-Dec 3.

text.p: Subscriptions to the initial public offering of clothing and footwear retailer Endysi SA, a new parallel market listing will take place during November 29-December 3, lead underwriter Omega Securities said in a statement.
Endysi will issue 600,000 common bearer shares at 750 drachmas a share, tapping the market for 450 million drachmas.
The company operates 10 stores in Greece and three in Bulgaria.

Endysi expects sales growth of 18.7 percent this year -- 1.52 billion drachmas -- and pretax profits of 285 million drachmas, up 15.3 percent on 1995. It is going public at a price earnings (P/E) ratio of 6.2.
The IPO proceeds will finance the expansion of its network to 20 stores in the next three years.

Issue advisor and lead underwriter is Omega Securities joined by co-underwriters ABN AMRO, General Bank, Interbank, European Popular Bank, National Mortgage Bank, Dorian Bank, NIBID, Alpha Brokerage and Nuntius Securities.
